title: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-125612)
description: CVE-2026-125612 is a high-severity SQL injection vulnerability in Deltaww DIAEnergie versions before 1.11.01.032. It allows improper neutralization of special elements in SQL commands, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries. This vulnerability impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
